title: Pistachio Martini Recipe
description: Who’s in the mood for a delightful twist on a classic martini ? If you’re looking to add a touch of elegance and exotic flair to your cocktail menu, then you’re in for a treat! Today, we’re looking into the nutty, creamy, and utterly irresistible Pistachio Martini recipe . But hold on a sec – why settle for the same old drinks on your menu when you can jazz things up with a unique, eye-catching sipper that’ll have your customers raving? Let’s be honest – everyone loves a good, Instagram-worthy cocktail that’s as delicious as it is photogenic, am I right?
author: Better Sweet Drinks
instructions:
1. Rim your martini glass with crushed pistachios for that extra flair.
    2. In a cocktail shaker, add ice, pistachio liqueur, vodka, vanilla syrup, and fresh lime juice.
    3. Shake it like a pro until it is well-chilled.
    4. Strain the mixture into your garnished martini glass.
notes:
• Crushed Pistachio Rim: Not only does it look fancy, but it also adds a delightful crunch to every sip!
  • Quality Ingredients: Use top-notch pistachio liqueur and fresh lime juice for the best flavor.
  • Shake, Don’t Stir: You want that perfect blend of flavors, so shake it up to get that delicious mix!
  • Presentation is Key: A beautifully presented cocktail is a memorable one – so have fun with your garnishes and glassware!
